name: Report to Helgrum
summary: At Kargath, Neeka Bloodscar gives you a fresh report for Helgrum the Swift in Stonard. You have just spoken with her there.

sections.title: A Report for Stonard
sections.body: Neeka Bloodscar gives you a fresh report for Helgrum in Stonard. She warns that anyone who calls themselves an outrunner must keep the way and avoid falling to an enemy.

sections.title: Helgrum Reads the Report
sections.body: Helgrum the Swift reads Neeka's report and learns that the Alliance has troubles of its own. He thinks the Horde and Alliance may share some enemies.

faq.q: Who sends you with the report?
faq.answer: Neeka Bloodscar has written a fresh report for Helgrum and asks you to carry it.

faq.q: Where does the report need to be delivered?
aliases: where to turn in report to helgrum
faq.answer: Deliver the report to Helgrum the Swift in Stonard.
This follows your earlier visit to Neeka Bloodscar at Kargath.
